_comment: INTERNAL targeting data — do NOT wire into a public route. Named-investor prospect list for the @sipiteno X dream-customer follow campaign. Distinct from pseo-site/content/target-list.ts (public channel/voice Dream-100). Extend this as new handles are vetted.

meta.followMechanism: Chrome MCP, logged in as @sipiteno; verify identity from live profile before follow
meta.standingAuth: Auto-follow clean customer fits; ask on borderline/distribution-only; skip off-target. Always pull LIVE bio before classifying (roles drift — see PaulYacoubian).
meta.countsNote: counts reflect ITEMIZED records[] only. An additional ~19 follows from the 2026-06-01 network-mining sweep (2nd-degree from already-followed accounts) are logged in agent memory (project_data_nerd_x_follow_campaign_2026_05_31) but NOT yet itemized here — so true live followed count is higher (~44). Backfill those handles when next re-vetted.

icp.name: Marcus
icp.definition: Emerging-manager / solo-GP / operator-investor (ex-founder who writes checks) / corp-dev / PE / non-eng VP. Price-sensitive (product is EUR 9.97-97/mo, positioned AGAINST six-figure data subscriptions for six-person funds).
icp.bestThesisFit: Dev-tools / OSS-infra / crypto-protocol investors — commit velocity IS their existing sourcing signal.

disqualifiers.megafundTier: a16z, Benchmark, 8VC, Lightspeed, Pantera, Dragonfly, Goodwater — build in-house, not buyers. Can still be strong DISTRIBUTION.
disqualifiers.consumerThesis: Consumer apps judged on DAU/app-store/retention, not GitHub. Weakest signal overlap.
disqualifiers.preSeedMissionDriven: Relationship/mission sourcing, not data; pre-seed repos too thin — signal fires seed->Series A.
disqualifiers.wrongSideOfTable: Fundraising coaches / founders not sourcing deals.
disqualifiers.geoCoverage: Corpus is US/EU-centric; non-US/EU investors fit on archetype but have thin pipeline coverage (product-feedback flag).
